name: Separator
summary: A thin line between groups of content, horizontal or vertical, with an optional short centered label.
useWhen: Between groups of items in a menu, a toolbar or a settings list
Between two ways to do one thing, with a label such as Or
Between a day of messages and the next, with the date as the label
avoidWhen: Between every item of a list: the gap already separates them
As the border of a panel or a card
To make room: the line adds no space of its own
A heading for the group that follows

orientation.description: horizontal runs along the line, between stacked groups. vertical stands between items in a row and stretches to its height. Sets data-orientation.

decorative.description: true: role none, hidden from assistive tech, drawn with color.border.subtle. false: role separator, announced, drawn with color.border.control, 3:1 on body and surface 1 to 3 (2.4 to 2.9 on surface 4 and 5 in the dark schemes and Neutral light). Sets data-decorative when true.

label.description: Short centered text on the line, for example Or. On a semantic separator it is the accessible name (aria-labelledby). Renders the label part and two line parts, and sets data-labelled.

a11y.role: separator when decorative is false, none when it is true (Radix Separator)
a11y.announce: A semantic separator is announced as a separator, with its label as the name. A decorative one is silent; its label text, if any, is read as plain text in the flow.
notes: A semantic separator is a boundary a person needs to see, so its line meets 3:1 against the surface (WCAG 1.4.11). A decorative line may be quieter.
The line is a border, so it stays visible in forced colors (CanvasText, GrayText when decorative).
The two line parts of a labelled separator are hidden from assistive tech.

en.label: One or two words in sentence case: Or, Older messages. No colon, no full stop.

ar.label: A short noun or particle: أو، الرسائل الأقدم. No diacritics.

react.note: No motion: a static line has nothing to animate, so no pattern from the catalog applies. No spacing prop: the gap of the parent Stack or Grid spaces the groups.

angular.behavior: [dsSeparator] directive with role and aria-orientation host bindings
angular.note: Label through content projection with the same line and label parts.

styles.studio: A 1px line in the subtle border color; Studio otherwise separates tiles by the 1px gap.
styles.neutral: A 1px line, the main way Neutral separates groups.
styles.liquid: A 1px line on solid content; glass bars use spacing instead.

mistakes.wrong: A separator between every row of a list
mistakes.right: A gap, or a separator only between groups

mistakes.wrong: An hr with margin-left and margin-right
mistakes.right: Separator inside a Stack, which spaces it with the gap

mistakes.wrong: A decorative separator that marks the only boundary between two forms
mistakes.right: decorative false, so it is announced and drawn at 3:1

mistakes.wrong: A long sentence as the label
mistakes.right: One or two words; a sentence belongs in a heading or a paragraph
